deep.reconstruction:
Context: the page is headed 'Was man mit Repsolds Kreise sehen kann' (what can be seen with Repsold's circle). It refers to the Repsold meridian circle of the Göttingen observatory, delivered around 1818-19. The page is an instrumental memorandum, not a mathematical derivation. Gauss works out which zenith distances in the meridian are visible, with full light, through the various openings of the observing slit: the northern and southern vertical flaps, the two sliders, and the two horizontal flaps.

(1) Upper table. Column 1 holds nominal circle readings with the circle East ('Kreis in Ost, nominell'). Column 2 holds the derived zenith distance (W.Z.D., the true zenith distance). The superscript 8.43 is the index (zenith-point) correction of 0°8'43". Every row satisfies z = r ± 0°8'43".
- North-side group (later prefixed '−'), z = r + 8'43":
  - 76°9'32" → 76°18'15"
  - 74°56'57" → 75°5'40"
  - 52°26'31" → 52°35'14"
  - 51°24'17" → 51°33'0"
  - 47°22'23" → 47°31'6"
  - 46°26'25" → 46°35'8"
  - The exception is 44°29'21" → 44°20'38", where 8'43" is subtracted (see errors).
- Unconverted entries: 48°13'49", +1°4'39" and +2°9'0" (the last two underlined). They appear to be preliminary readings.
- South-side group, z = r − 8'43" (consistent with the zenith point lying at nominal reading 0°8'43"):
  - 1°4'30" → 0°55'47"
  - 2°5'27" → 1°56'44"
  - 46°10'22" → 46°1'39"
  - 47°2'50" → 46°54'7"
  - 48°13'50" → 48°5'7"
  - 49°1'22" → 48°52'39"
  - 53°9'30" → 53°0'47"
  - 54°10'10" → 54°1'27"
- The asterisked rows are the boundary positions, where the field of the objective just becomes fully unobstructed by the next part of the opening.

(2) Lower table. 'Es muss also, um volles Licht zu haben, offen seyn' (for full light the following must be open), for zenith distances 'bis Z.D.' (north negative, south positive):
- up to −75°5'40": the (whole) north vertical flap
- up to −51°33'0": the upper part of the N.V.K.
- up to −47°31'6": the northern slider
- up to −44°20'38": the northern slider together with the northern horizontal flap
- up to +0°55'56" (table: 0°55'47"): the northern horizontal flap
- up to +1°56'44": both horizontal flaps
- up to +46°1'39": the southern horizontal flap
- up to +48°52'39": the S.H.Kl. together with the southern slider
- up to +53°0'47": the southern slider
- beyond (+): the upper part of the S.V.Kl., then the whole S.V.Kl.

The limits are exactly the asterisked converted values of the upper table. The only computation is applying the constant index correction ±8'43".
errors: The row 44°29'21" → 44°20'38" subtracts 8'43", although all other north-side (−) rows add 8'43". Applying the north-side rule would give 44°38'4". Either this reading belongs to the other side or convention, or Gauss slipped. It cannot be decided from the page.

The lower table gives the limit for 'die nördl. horiz. Klappe' as +0°55'56". The upper table gives 0°55'47" (= 1°4'30" − 8'43"). Either Gauss made a copying slip of 9", or the 56 is a misreading of 47.
Unconverted entries 48°13'49", +1°4'39" and +2°9'0" stand without zenith distances. +1°4'39" ≈ 1°4'30", and +2°9'0" differs from 2°5'27". These look like preliminary readings, later superseded.

results.what: Reduction of nominal circle readings to zenith distances by a constant index (zenith-point) correction of 8'43", with opposite sign on the two sides of the zenith
results.modern_name: Zenith-point (index error) correction for a meridian circle

results.what: Table of zenith-distance ranges over which each meridian-slit shutter (vertical flaps, sliders, horizontal flaps) must be open for unvignetted light on the Repsold meridian circle at Göttingen
results.usually_credited_to: Gauss as director of Göttingen observatory (instrumental practice)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a purely operational observatory note: index-corrected circle readings and a table of which shutters to open for given zenith distances. It contains no mathematics beyond adding or subtracting 8'43".

checkable.asserts: anomalous north row uses subtraction of 8'43"
9" discrepancy between lower-table limit 0°55'56" and upper-table value 0°55'47"

transcription_corrections: '{+8.43+}' is a superscript above 'Kreis in Ost.' giving the index correction 8'43" (the constant difference between the columns), not an insertion.
'(-Die ganze-) N. Vert. Klappe': 'Die ganze' is struck through, consistent with the transcription.
'die obre Theil der S.V.Kl.' in the image reads 'die obre Theil' (probably intended 'der obre Theil').
